_my_una_doctor_opt_show_activity: Show activity graphic during protected operations
_my_una_doctor_opt_show_activity_info: Show Doctor's animated working indicator while a protected operation is being processed.
_my_una_doctor_opt_expand_technical_deta: Open technical evidence and diagnostic details by default instead of leaving them collapsed.
_my_una_doctor_opt_work_cycle_size_info: Choose how many runtime files Doctor may process in one protected browser work cycle. Hard internal safety limits still apply.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_show_head: Show the My UNA Doctor branding and trust header on the public maintenance page.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_show_foot: Show the closing My UNA Doctor maintenance footer.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_heading_i: Personalize the main heading visitors see while maintenance is active.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_message_i: Personalize the main message explaining the temporary maintenance period.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_patience_: Message displayed beneath the maintenance countdown.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_return_me: Message shown beneath the countdown while the estimated return time is active.
_my_una_doctor_opt_maintenance_footer_me: Personalize the closing message shown in the maintenance page footer.
_my_una_doctor_opt_use_maintenance_page_: When enabled, Doctor uses its branded maintenance page with video, live server health and personalized text. When disabled, Doctor preserves and uses the site's existing UNA maintenance page.
